items.title: 68642_Jo Jones oral history interview
items.q: Incidentally, without Jimmy Crawford do you know I never would have left Kansas City with Basie? He begged me

ctx.x: Hey, you know who we didn't mention - Old Gal - Jimmy Crawford.

You mean the one I said, send-for to him? It's like preparing a meal. You can fix the cake but if you leave the sweetening out of it you ain't got no cake. He's the most beautiful man, you know. Naturally Mr. Lunceford had the long baton. The band's style involved itself loosely musically around Willie Smith but as a result the two-beat thing that Crawford did - you and I both knew a drummer by the name of Brown used to play at the Beale Street Theatre in Memphis. Crawford had the thing. Incidentally, without…

You remember Maxey ? He was with Cab Calloway when I joined in '36. You remember Maxey, a great drummer. I'm glad you mentioned his name. I'll tell you another guy we didn't mention yet. Of course we haven't gotten to this one fellow I'd like to say right now.

items.title: 63476_Jimmie Crawford oral history interview
items.q: Don't do that. Get down. Don't do that, friendly as we are.

ctx.x: Yeah. Joe had finished his solo, and he went in the back. Naturally, wrapped himself in a towel around his neck like he -- a prize fighter or something and wouldn't -- sat in the back, way back there somewhere. And so I enjoyed his solo, so I -- was going to -- I'm retired now. I just wanted to see how my hands felt on the drum. He sat in on my drums many times.

And I sat down and started doing some of his things, da-dump-tee-tee-tee, ka-ka-kuh, you know, that kind of stuff, that old (inaudible), and Joe ran up there and grabbed my arm and tried to pull it out of the socket. Don't do that. Get down. Don't do that, friendly as we are.

I politely got up, told my wife, come on, baby, let's go. I got out of there. While he was playing his solo, though, Matthew Gee Jean walked in front of him on the bandstand. He was only (inaudible). And Joe screamed bloody murder at Matthew Gee Jean. If this was Buddy Rich, you wouldn't walk in front of him. I said, what the hell is that. That man said -- why did he say that? If this was Buddy Rich, you wouldn't walk in front of him.
